QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` returns `x` through `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` when assembly is available. Otherwise it returns `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`... The stated purpose is that the compiler cannot prove the value at compile time
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the opacity barrier that stops the compiler from knowing a value, and it places the primitives in library/constant_time_impl.h.
